visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing a black shirt over a gray t-shirt and small hoop earrings, is seated in a gaming chair. He gestures with his hands while speaking in front of a white background featuring anime posters and a collectible figure. Large yellow-outlined text captions appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a digital character selection menu from a video game, displaying a grid of various male character portraits. A circular inset appears in the center showing a person wearing a yellow tiger mask. The background UI is dark with gold and white text indicating game currency and levels. (3) A close-up shot features a man holding a black Nintendo Switch console, smiling with closed eyes and visible joy. Small pink heart icons are edited to float around him. He is in a bright studio environment with shelves holding collectibles, a Red Bull fridge, and studio lighting equipment visible behind him. (4) A woman with long hair and bangs, wearing a gray blazer, is shown holding a Switch and laughing. The frame is split, showing her reaction above and the gameplay footage below. The gameplay shows a 3D urban street environment at night where multiple characters are engaged in a chaotic brawling combat sequence. (5) The man from the first phase is shown again, laughing hysterically while looking at the screen. The scene transitions between reaction shots of the three individuals and fast-paced gameplay footage. Characters in the game perform high-speed attacks with vibrant particle effects. Yellow variety captions frequently flash on screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 《人中之龍0 誓約的場所 導演剪輯版》首次推出的線上多人對戰「踢館線上對戰」. [Logo]: @6tan. [Subtitle]: 它可以線上四人連線. (2) [Subtitle]: 跟其他玩家合作的 PVE 模式. [Variety]: 這個模式登場的角色非常多. [Variety]: 這不是一堆都雜魚嗎. (3) [Variety]: 欸很讚耶. [Subtitle]: 他的副標真的很棒欸. (4) [Variety]: 偷窺狂柴田. [Variety]: 好普通的一個人喔. (5) [Subtitle]: 誰是莉老先生. [Subtitle]: 我要去搶博愛座. (6) [Subtitle]: 我要怎麼開槍啊. [Subtitle]: 我選那個角色的時候寫說我裝備一把九釐米手槍. [Subtitle]: 可是我從頭到尾都不能開槍到底是怎樣啦. (7) [Subtitle]: 如果我們選四個老人家我們會不會搞不清楚自己在拿裡. [Variety]: 咖哩仔. (8) [Variety]: 超高齡社會的樣子. [Variety]: 太快了吧. [Variety]: 哇速度感十足. [Variety]: 親楚一尾活龍啊. (9) [Variety]: 我以為我被打死了欸. [Variety]: 我也以為有一個老頭猝死了. (10) [Variety]: 雜魚Meta就是那個莉老. [Subtitle]: 哇老爸得了MVP. [Variety]: 他最強喔. [Variety]: 最快最強.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice introduces the game mode with a friendly, energetic tone. An upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM with a strong synthesized beat starts immediately. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition to gameplay. Digital UI 'clicks' and chimes are heard as the menu changes. The male voice continues with a comedic, high-pitched inflection, followed by a burst of group laughter. (3) Sound effects of physical impacts (thuds, smashes) from the game become prominent. A female voice joins with a high-pitched, excited exclamation, laughing as the music beat continues. (4) The audio becomes hyper-dense with multiple speakers talking simultaneously over constant fighting SFX (punches and vocal grunts from game characters). A 'pop' SFX is heard as variety text flashes. (5) The phase concludes with loud, high-valence laughter from all three main speakers. A short, triumphant musical stinger plays as the scene ends, followed by a final enthusiastic comment from the first male voice.
